::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 10th 1887  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Trinity College, Cambridge Cullum Q81
:::

My dear [Mrs Sumner](people/person_1381.qmd)

I shall be very happy to come to luncheon on Thursday  Please do not wait for me if I am a few minutes late for I shall not be able to set off till 12.30, and the roads <u>may</u> be as bad as they are today!

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Envelope addressed to Mrs Sumner/ The Close/ Winchester and postmarked Winchester 10 January 1887.
